responsibility: Implements the main handwritten target hooks and helper routines for VAX code generation. This file owns option override handling, address legitimacy and cost modeling, RTL cost estimation, CC-mode compatibility, asm adjustment for PSL clobbers, calling-convention hooks for argument passing and struct returns, prologue generation, libfunc and thunk setup, trampoline emission and initialization, return-pop semantics, frame layout decisions, and other targetm callbacks that connect GCC’s generic RTL backend to VAX-specific ABI and instruction semantics.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-name VAX files, this is the handwritten C++ implementation file for target hooks and runtime backend logic. It supplies executable code such as option override handling, address/cost and calling-convention hooks, prologue/trampoline routines, and frame decisions, whereas vax.h provides macro definitions, vax.md provides RTL patterns, and vax.opt declares options.
